(* ---- Jordan's inequality, proved by monotonicity ---- *)

lemma jd_u: fixes t :: real assumes t0: "0 \<le> t" and tpi: "t \<le> pi"
  shows "t * cos t \<le> sin t"
proof -
  let ?f = "\<lambda>x::real. sin x - x * cos x"
  have der: "\<And>x::real. DERIV ?f x :> x * sin x"
    by (intro derivative_eq_intros) (simp add: field_simps)
  have step: "\<And>x::real. 0 \<le> x \<Longrightarrow> x \<le> t \<Longrightarrow> \<exists>y. DERIV ?f x :> y \<and> 0 \<le> y"
  proof -
    fix x :: real assume "0 \<le> x" "x \<le> t"
    then have "0 \<le> x * sin x"
      using tpi sin_ge_zero[of x] by (auto intro!: mult_nonneg_nonneg)
    then show "\<exists>y. DERIV ?f x :> y \<and> 0 \<le> y" using der[of x] by blast
  qed
  have "?f 0 \<le> ?f t" by (rule DERIV_nonneg_imp_nondecreasing[OF t0 step])
  then show ?thesis by simp
qed

lemma jd_half: fixes t :: real assumes t0: "0 < t" and tpi: "t \<le> pi / 2"
  shows "2 / pi * t \<le> sin t"
proof -
  let ?g = "\<lambda>x::real. sin x / x"
  have der: "\<And>x::real. 0 < x \<Longrightarrow> DERIV ?g x :> (cos x * x - sin x * 1) / x\<^sup>2"
    using DERIV_divide[OF DERIV_sin DERIV_ident] by (simp add: power2_eq_square)
  have step: "\<And>x::real. t \<le> x \<Longrightarrow> x \<le> pi / 2 \<Longrightarrow> \<exists>y. DERIV ?g x :> y \<and> y \<le> 0"
  proof -
    fix x :: real assume "t \<le> x" "x \<le> pi / 2"
    then have x0: "0 < x" using t0 by simp
    have "x * cos x \<le> sin x" using jd_u[of x] x0 `x \<le> pi / 2` pi_half_le_two_pi by linarith
    then have "cos x * x - sin x * 1 \<le> 0" by (simp add: mult.commute)
    then have "(cos x * x - sin x * 1) / x\<^sup>2 \<le> 0"
      using divide_nonpos_pos[of "cos x * x - sin x * 1" "x\<^sup>2"] x0 by simp
    then show "\<exists>y. DERIV ?g x :> y \<and> y \<le> 0" using der[OF x0] by blast
  qed
  have "?g (pi / 2) \<le> ?g t" by (rule DERIV_nonpos_imp_nonincreasing[OF t0[THEN less_imp_le] tpi step])
  then have h: "2 / pi \<le> sin t / t" by (simp add: field_simps)
  show ?thesis using h t0 by (simp add: pos_le_divide_eq field_simps)
qed

  shows "2 / pi * s \<le> sin t"
proof (cases "t \<le> pi / 2")
  case True
  have "2 / pi * t \<le> sin t"
  proof (cases "t = 0")
    case True then show ?thesis by simp
  next
    case False
    then have "0 < t" using st s0 by linarith
    then show ?thesis using jd_half[OF _ True] by simp
  qed

  ultimately show ?thesis by linarith
next

  have "2 / pi * s \<le> 2 / pi * (pi - t)" using sp by (intro mult_left_mono) auto

    using jd_half[of "pi - t"] False tpi s0 st by (cases "pi - t = 0") auto

proof -

      by (rule DERIV_diff[OF DERIV_sin d1])

  qed
  have step: "\<And>x::real. 0 \<le> x \<Longrightarrow> x \<le> t \<Longrightarrow> \<exists>y. DERIV ?f x :> y \<and> 0 \<le> y"
  proof -
    fix x :: real assume "0 \<le> x" "x \<le> t"

  then show ?thesis by simp

  shows "2 / pi * t \<le> sin t"

  have der: "\<And>x::real. 0 < x \<Longrightarrow> DERIV ?g x :> (cos x * x - sin x * 1) / x\<^sup>2"

    fix x :: real assume x0: "0 < x"
    have "x \<noteq> 0" using x0 by simp
    then show "DERIV ?g x :> (cos x * x - sin x * 1) / x\<^sup>2"

  qed
  have step: "\<And>x::real. t \<le> x \<Longrightarrow> x \<le> pi / 2 \<Longrightarrow> \<exists>y. DERIV ?g x :> y \<and> y \<le> 0"
  proof -
